parsed.rationale: All four participating records reside in `Shared/Artwork/Tests/ArtworkTests/ArtworkFetcherTests.swift` and belong to inner types named `SequentialMockSession` nested inside test classes (`LastFMArtworkServiceTests`, `DiscogsArtworkServiceTests` ×2, `iTunesArtworkServiceTests`). Every record is therefore a test fixture by location and naming convention. Extracting a default implementation for the `data` property into a shared protocol extension would couple production or shared framework code to test-only mock semantics, which is precisely the anti-pattern the restraint rule guards against. No structural evidence (jaccard, shared_field_count, differing_slots) is available to further motivate an action, reinforcing the no-action conclusion.
